contact_other_permille.reason: protocol 310 (the final Legion steering of 2026-11-02, docs/legion-deep-dive-2026-11-02.md sections 3-6 and the commit messages: a06d3f80 + c4933aa8 travel speed for an unturned step except a plain mover's flow-around shuffle and the in-reach press, 740f0bd9 + 566fc41a no flow-around shuffle behind the aim for formation members, 75925618 + 8dcb123f a press for non-engaging legs, 6e8c1dd6 the press-in fix, 3b09f132 the still-turn fix): bound moved 604 -> 652 at the L310 gate (bound <= 604, got 652), for the lead's ruling. Was 604: protocol 280 (Legion ~100 round 2, 2026-10-19): a formation member's flow-around shuffle keeps travel speed on a move-like leg (legion.cpp Member::detourFlow; the committed one-cell step round a blocking body crept at the facing cap, an eighth of travel speed sideways), so crowds flow round each other and obstacles sooner: more blocked steps are flowed round (slides) and held between them (holds), bodies press closer (contact) and settle sooner (still-scan samples, completion distances): contact_other_permille 604 at the P280 gate. Was 590: bound moved 585 -> 590 at the stage-8 gate. stage 8 (protocol 272, 2026-10-17, Legion chokepoints, subgroups and arrivals): in aware-unseen, formation members gaining on their own slot, or with a free step toward it, are no longer settled short of it (legion.cpp Member::windowSlotDist, freeTowardSlot): the front of a crowd takes the far side of its area, completions stand nearer their slots (and farther from the click), and in a cramped area the last bodies queue longer instead of settling where they stand. Before: W9 exit, bound raised 483 -> 585: W9 exit (lane C step C1, decision 7 / W9-U2, protocol 248): the head-on meet of the 16+ columns narrows before contact (aware-unseen click a00 / b00 t90 2162 / 2207 -> 1757 / 1792 against Retail 1877 / 1929; every aware-* click t90 and done is faster; groups' cross contacts pair.contacts fall 4-50x). The aware fixtures' observers are one-body groups, so contact_other counts a body's own click-mates, and the narrowed column packs the click closer (the W3 exit licensed the same cause); the work counters rise by the extra steering of the latched Points (line sweeps, trace cells, still units, slides, slot search) and the completion-distance classes (a body or two settles 1-2 cells further out). Pinned at the exit value.

work.still_units_processed.max.reason: a work class that did not move here before: stage 4 (protocol 268, 2026-10-16, Legion fair scheduling and budgets): in refreshchurn-control, its map exceeds 131k cells, so a first footprint-legality plane is no longer built inside the registration that needs it (a whole-map build in one call) but as an incremental job (kPlaneBuildBudget units a tick, legion.cpp planeReady/buildPlanes); the order's registrations wait for it and run in the tick it is ready instead of at command time, so every registration stamp (windows, stall, seed and reseed ticks) moves by at least a tick; and field work is now served by job (a field, however many groups share it) in four classes -- Waiting, FirstRoute, AwareRepair, StaleRefresh -- each by deficit round robin over a window of its oldest jobs (kWindow 12, kRefreshWindow 3, kSlice 32768) with age promotion, instead of whole quotas to the lowest group id first; a start is admitted oldest first with a bounded fit scan, charges its initialisation (cells/16) to the quota, and the field cap is a fixed byte allowance (128 MiB) instead of 48 whole maps of cells (legion.cpp serveFields, sim/navbudget.h). Bodies whose order waits for its plane's first build stand idle meanwhile, so scanStill samples them as still bodies (1 at the stage-4 gate)

Before: bound moved 27 -> 26 at the stage-4 gate (inside the stage-3 base's own core-offset spread). stage 4 (protocol 268, 2026-10-16, Legion fair scheduling and budgets): in split-450-pocket, its map exceeds 131k cells, so a first footprint-legality plane is no longer built inside the registration that needs it (a whole-map build in one call) but as an incremental job (kPlaneBuildBudget units a tick, legion.cpp planeReady/buildPlanes); the order's registrations wait for it and run in the tick it is ready instead of at command time, so every registration stamp (windows, stall, seed and reseed ticks) moves by at least a tick; and field work is now served by job (a field, however many groups share it) in four classes -- Waiting, FirstRoute, AwareRepair, StaleRefresh -- each by deficit round robin over a window of its oldest jobs (kWindow 12, kRefreshWindow 3, kSlice 32768) with age promotion, instead of whole quotas to the lowest group id first; a start is admitted oldest first with a bounded fit scan, charges its initialisation (cells/16) to the quota, and the field cap is a fixed byte allowance (128 MiB) instead of 48 whole maps of cells (legion.cpp serveFields, sim/navbudget.h). Before: bound moved 31 -> 27 at the stage-3 gate. protocol 267 (Legion 10,000 stage 3, explicit selection orders, 2026-10-15): split-450-pocket issues 450 unit commands in one tick (its largest click 450 bodies); the per-unit uplink landed them 64 a tick over 8 ticks, an explicit order lands each click whole in its activation tick, so the bodies start together instead of in 64-body waves.
